items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: with Leonard Brown by the way

ctx.x: I don’t know since he died. I remember the last time I saw him, with Leonard Brown by the way, was about four or five years ago and he was getting ready to move… I don’t know. I know he had moved in it and established, but I don’t know if it’s going to this day without him.

OK, (it was) always a pleasure to play with Von, you never knew what he was going to play. He was a beautiful ballad player like Gene Ammons, and that he could play ballads. He could play as lyrical as you want, and go as out as you want to go. He’s one of those very special legends and I’m really happy to have the association… To play with him and glad to share this NEA award along with him.
